title: fix(service-datasource)!: a datasource create may not name a stored credential reference; the settings handle door is pinned as it holds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXVCzWzmBkGHAYQZPucaktq)_

Fixes #27722

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cy83ynufEsjN8PwPoh (card thread)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据源管理入口的「新建」不再接受请求里自带的 `external.credentialsRef`，一律以 400 拒绝，且不写入任何东西；新建记录只保存它自己这次 `secret` 封存后得到的那个引用。设置服务的密文句柄写入口经实测本来就关着（每个值都重新封存、从不收引用），本 PR 只给它加钉。
- 为什么改：卡上要求按 #27582 的同一条规则审两个凭据引用写入口：「非系统写入只能封存新值，或保留本记录自己的引用」。实测数据源新建入口会原样保存请求带来的引用，不符合规则；编辑入口与设置入口符合。
- 风险与回滚：拒绝发生在任何记录、密文或连接池写入之前；无论引用指向什么，答复都相同，消息里不出现引用值。控制台的数据源表单从不发送这个键，不受影响。编辑行为不变。回滚只需 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts`（`createDatasource` 开头的 `assertNoDraftCredentialsRef`），两个新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/datasource-credentials-ref-own-reference.test.ts`（10/10）与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run src/settings-secret-handle-own-reference.pin.test.ts`（2/2）。
- 需要你做的：无需操作；本 PR 是收窄（narrowing），落地前需一次契约复审，由席位安排。

## What changes

The card audits two credential-reference write doors against the rule #27582 set (PR #27695): **a non-system write may only seal a new value or keep its own record's stored reference.**

**Door 2, datasource `external.credentialsRef` (fixed).** The admin door's create (`POST /api/v1/datasources`, `IDatasourceAdminService.createDatasource`) now refuses a draft that names `external.credentialsRef`:

- A create has no stored reference of its own, so the only reference it may store is the one its own `secret` is bound under.
- The refusal is thrown before anything is written (no record, no secret, no pool), as the route's `400`. The message names the key and never its value, and the answer is the same whatever the value names.
- Every caller of this door is a signed-in operator through the admin routes; nothing system-side writes through it, so there is no pass-through to keep.
- The update path already keeps the record's own reference unless a supplied secret rewraps it. It is pinned here, unchanged.

**Door 1, settings-service credential handles (holds, pinned).** `setMany` seals every value it is handed for a declared-encrypted key and stores the handle that seal minted, so no caller can make the stored handle one it did not mint. The pin names a live handle another organization's write minted.

The #27695 helper (`SecretRefWriteError`, `encryptSecretFields`) is not shareable here: it lives in an `@objectstack/objectql` internal module that nothing re-exports, this package does not depend on objectql, and its judge reads a record's stored column, which a create does not have. The refusal here is the door's own, in the shape its sibling validation refusals already take.

## Why

The card's audit, measured on `origin/main` at 3702be40: door 2's create stored a draft's `external.credentialsRef` as given; door 2's update and door 1 did not let a caller set the stored reference. Only the door that measured open is changed.

## Verification

- New pins: `service-datasource` `datasource-credentials-ref-own-reference.test.ts` (10 cases) and `service-settings` `settings-secret-handle-own-reference.pin.test.ts` (2 cases).
- Ablations, each restored: removing the create refusal reds the 5 refusal cases; letting an update keep the patch's reference reds the 2 update pins; letting the settings door store a submitted value as the handle reds both settings pins.
- Package suites: `service-datasource` 1021/1021, `service-settings` 1016/1016. `pnpm typecheck` in both packages: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at the committed head, plus `pnpm lint`: 61 commands derived. 60 exit 0 (`check:engine-double-contract` first flagged the settings pin's secret-store fake as an engine double; the fake was trimmed to the store members the pin uses, and the gate re-runs exit 0). `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (prerequisite: a whole-tree build); it is re-run after `pnpm build` and reported in the report comment. `pnpm lint`: exit 0.

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the datasource admin door's create refuses a draft that names `external.credentialsRef`, where it stored the value as given before. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none

The changeset is `patch` on `@objectstack/service-datasource` with the BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 disposition. `service-settings` gains a test file only and publishes nothing.
